The XV name was used in Australia from 2012. From 2023 the third generation was renamed Crosstrek in all markets (except North America, where it was already Crosstrek). The same model line is still sold in Australia as the Crosstrek, so year_to 2023 means the XV name ended, not that the model stopped. Standard AWD crossover, so passenger class. Engines (boxer petrol, with an e-Boxer mild hybrid on newer models) not verified for each year, so fuel and engine are left blank.
